name: gold-bot-assets
description: Build-time only. cPanel has no Node runtime — public/assets/{css,js} are committed and shipped.

scripts.build: tailwindcss -i resources/css/app.css -o public/assets/css/app.css --minify && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: cp node_modules/@alpinejs/csp/dist/cdn.min.js public/assets/js/alpine-csp.min.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js public/assets/js/chart.min.js && cp resources/js/app.js public/assets/js/app.js
